_comment: Reference shape only — the live authorized-target list is in MongoDB now (src/security_toolkit/scope_db.py), not a local file. Use `python scripts/manage_scope.py add` to add a target (or `python scripts/migrate_scope_to_mongo.py` to import an old local scope.json). Only ever add systems your team owns or has written authorization to test. The 'auth' block is only needed for the IDOR tester (scripts/run_idor_test.py) — see src/security_toolkit/recon/auth.py for the full schema per type.
